description: Defines data structures and classes for managing resource grid allocations in a 5G NR scheduler, including grant info, carrier resource grids, and slot resource management.

classes.name: carrier_subslot_resource_grid
classes.description: Manages symbol x CRB resource grid for a carrier, including allocation, clearing, and collision detection.

classes.name: cell_slot_resource_grid
classes.description: Handles RB and symbol allocations across multiple carriers within a cell for a specific slot.

classes.name: cell_slot_resource_allocator
classes.description: Stores scheduling info for a specific slot and cell, including allocated grants for DL and UL.

classes.name: cell_resource_allocator
classes.description: Circular buffer managing resource allocations over multiple slots, with history for error handling.

methods.name: get_carrier_rb_dims
methods.description: Derives carrier CRB limits from scs-specific carrier configuration.

methods.name: carrier_subslot_resource_grid::clear
methods.description: Clears the resource grid for a carrier.

methods.name: carrier_subslot_resource_grid::fill
methods.description: Allocates symbol x CRB range or list in the carrier resource grid.

methods.name: carrier_subslot_resource_grid::collides
methods.description: Checks for collision with other allocations in the carrier resource grid.

methods.name: carrier_subslot_resource_grid::used_crbs
methods.description: Returns bitmap of occupied/unavailable CRBs in the carrier.

methods.name: carrier_subslot_resource_grid::used_prbs
methods.description: Returns bitmap of occupied/unavailable PRBs in the carrier.

methods.name: carrier_subslot_resource_grid::all_set
methods.description: Checks if a symbol x CRB range is fully set.

methods.name: cell_slot_resource_grid::clear
methods.description: Clears allocations in the resource grid.

methods.name: cell_slot_resource_grid::fill
methods.description: Allocates grants or CRB lists in the resource grid.

methods.name: cell_slot_resource_grid::collides
methods.description: Checks for collisions with other allocations.

methods.name: cell_slot_resource_allocator::slot_indication
methods.description: Sets new slot for the allocator.

methods.name: cell_slot_resource_allocator::clear
methods.description: Resets all allocations and scheduling results.

methods.name: cell_resource_allocator::slot_indication
methods.description: Indicates processing of a new slot.

methods.name: cell_resource_allocator::operator[]
methods.description: Accesses resource grid for a specific slot delay or slot point.

methods.name: cell_resource_allocator::get_history
methods.description: Retrieves past slot decision for a given slot.
